support_and_basis.ADV20_policy: Observed genuine-volume lower bound,only days with>=98%scheduled valid bars;mean16+oflast20calendar sessions,split-normalized to current rawshare units. Missing volume cannot inflate ADV; lower ADV raises modeled impact. Not a claim of complete consolidated full-session volume.
support_and_basis.M04_volume: Cumulative observed opening-to-decision volume,compared with prior20same-clock cumulative volumes,not future daily total.
support_and_basis.R06_factor: Each current stock uses leave-one-out equal-weight daily-return factor,>=12available peers each day. Last60calendar sessions,min50paired fit;last5residuals complete.
support_and_basis.current_reference: Full-hour slot uses exact received close of preceding minute;opening slot uses completed first minute,decision09:33ET. Gap uses that minute open. r60at10:30 uses0930open to1029close;later r60uses exact60minute-separated closes within session. No missing-slot compression.
support_and_basis.daily_range_policy: Strict all scheduled bars valid; incomplete day high/low unknown,breakout abstains if any of prior20daily ranges unknown
support_and_basis.pair_atomic: Joint valid-bar fill or neither;no entry lifetime extension. Exit waits keep both inventory/carry. No prospective bar price for order acceptance.
support_and_basis.quality_outcomes: Unfunded observed-bar open-to-open price returns,split-normalized;special-distribution crossing flagged/censored for price-only quality while funded economics remain booked. Opposite-sign null uses identical eligible outcomes.
support_and_basis.signal_prices: Causal split-genesis units: raw price times cumulative effective split ratio since2020-01; raw volumes divided by same factor. Future splits never rescale earlier feature rows. Price-only,not dividend-total-return adjusted.
support_and_basis.support_rationale: 80%of fixed calendar windows is explicit causal support,not compression to last-valid days. Strict range extrema require full observed interval;ADVuses a declared conservative lower bound. Fixed before returns,not tuned.
